scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof of a sharp norm and mesh–power asymptotics; finite calculations provide supplementary checks only; no independent review.
scientific_limitations: Three distinct real sites, degree-one generalized Floater–Hormann blending and positive integer exponents only; no many-node convergence or finite-precision error theorem. Historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp three-site stability and a mesh–power boundary layer for generalized Floater–Hormann interpolation
